## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, twenty-fourth sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, and 1.5 to the 10th power approximated to two significant figures.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Markov chain with an absorbing state: a tennis game is at deuce and each point is won independently with probability p. What is the probability of winning the game from deuce? Derive it, then evaluate at p of 0.55 and note how much the advantage amplifies.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The same amplification, asked as a trading question: your edge per trade is 51 to 49. Over a match structure that requires winning by two, what does your edge become? Say what the analogy is to compounding a small per-trade edge.
:::
:::
